title: Hub timers: store, revert, cancel, restart
goal: A timed switch reverts on time from the hub alone
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "yes to both", including a timed switch in Grover ("spegni il ventilatore per 2 ore") via MCP behind NERV's approval. Italian is required for every model-facing feature.
A switch_timers table and a scheduler in the hub; Commands.switch takes an optional duration and records the timer; revert goes through Commands with source timer, logged like any actuation

Tests with a fake clock and mock drivers: revert on time with NERV absent, overdue revert after a hub restart, cancel on a later switch, stop-all and mode change, agent offline at revert → retry and an alert, refusal of a duration on a pump
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: a table, a scheduler and the restart path in the hub, with fake-clock tests. Not a measurement.
